entry.title: Maxwell’s demon with memory
entry.summary:
Nature Physics, Published online: 23 October 2026; doi:10.1038/s41567-026-03509-8 Maxwell’s demon may produce work using the information it obtains by measuring the system as fuel. Now, it is shown that the amount of produced work increases if the demon takes information about the dynamical correlations of the system into account.

Source: Nature Physics · Tags: #quantum-physics #optics-photonics

entry.title: Particle collisions on a quantum computer
entry.summary:
Nature Physics, Published online: 23 October 2026; doi:10.1038/s41567-026-03490-2 Elementary particle physics rests on the discovery of particles produced in high-energy collider experiments. Now, a model collision above the threshold for particle production has been simulated on a quantum computer.

Source: Nature Physics · Tags: #quantum-physics #optics-photonics

entry.title: Beating the break-even point with autonomous quantum error correction
entry.summary:
Nature Physics, Published online: 23 October 2026; doi:10.1038/s41567-026-03486-y Conventional quantum error correction requires repeated measurements and real-time feedback, which are technically complex. An autonomous implementation that eliminates these while beating the break-even point is demonstrated in a trapped-ion system.

Source: Nature Physics · Tags: #quantum-physics #optics-photonics #quantum-computing
